sheet.ttsNone: No TTS voice on this character yet
sheet.linkedHint: Look and TTS come from the library character. Acting notes stay on this story or series.

facePackMaker.title: Lipsync face (cube plane)
facePackMaker.intro: For a talking character: generate a square face texture (skin fills the cube front — eyes, nose, rest mouth). Then edit only the mouth (visemes) or only the eyes (expressions). Drop the stills here to build the 9×6 pack. Skin color is locked to rest so talking does not flash.
facePackMaker.restPrompt: Rest plane prompt (1:1, any image generator)
facePackMaker.naming: Files: rest.png, A.png, M.png, happy.png, angry.png. Missing visemes alias I=E, U=O, F=M, L=A.

speechWorkshop.title: Prepare 2D speech
speechWorkshop.intro: Prepare a reusable character once: choose a base, position mouth pieces, preview, review and save. You do not need a 3D turnaround.

sprites.title: Mouth overlays
sprites.detail: Use a ready-made mouth pack in the editor below. Cover the original mouth first; generic lips may not match detailed art. Custom sprites can also be assigned from scene layers.

patches.title: Raster face patches
patches.detail: Import an aligned face variant. Its skin/beard covers the original mouth. Same identity does not guarantee alignment. Do not remove its background.

software.title: External lip-sync software
software.detail: Rhubarb creates mouth timings, not artwork. MuseTalk changes the face using a model. Neither is connected here yet.

speechWorkshop.manualOnly: Use existing mouth packs or click the AI generation buttons to create new ones. Nothing is generated until you request it. Review the base and each mouth, then save the speech character.
speechWorkshop.name: New character name
speechWorkshop.importHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MiB. Choosing a file or a HocusPocus image does not upload it. Upload creates a pending base, not an approved character. Files are retained even if you discard the draft.
speechWorkshop.approvePose: I have reviewed this base image
speechWorkshop.singlePack: Current limit: one mouth pack per character. Patches are bound to their exact pose and source; do not overwrite a working pack to prepare another view.
speechWorkshop.previewReady: A closed and an open mouth are reviewed. You can test the swap; this does not certify visual quality or phonetic lip-sync.
speechWorkshop.previewNotReady: Review the base and at least a closed and an open mouth before judging animation. Existing text previews are heuristic, not phonetic lip-sync.
speechWorkshop.unsaved: Unsaved changes. This tab keeps a recovery draft per workspace when you navigate away. Save to keep it on the server; recovery is best-effort if browser storage is unavailable. Discard and reload explicitly removes the draft.
speechWorkshop.errorHint: No automatic retry or overwrite. Your draft is retained on save failure; if another editor saved first, resolve it before discarding and reloading.
speechWorkshop.invalidImport: Enter a name and choose a non-empty PNG, JPEG or WebP of at most 20 MiB.
speechWorkshop.invalidUpload: The upload did not return a persistent image URL.
speechWorkshop.invalidSave: The server did not return the saved character.
speechWorkshop.imported: Base uploaded. Review it in the preview, then save the character explicitly.
speechWorkshop.saved: Character saved to this workspace. Visual and audio validation remain separate.
speechWorkshop.completeSet: {{count}}/{{total}} assigned mouths approved. Speaking shots need an approved mouth for every assigned sound; you can save unfinished work and complete it later.

library.title: Cutout characters
library.subtitle: A character is a body + mouths placed on top. You can also prepare it in Character Creator → Prepare 2D speech.
library.newHint: For a new character: select its drawing on the canvas, name it, and create it.
library.createFromSelected: New character from the selected drawing

advanced.hint: Only if the drawing is already in the scene. Select it and assign it. The normal path is to generate or clean in Mouths and eyes.

library.deleteTitle: Delete only the card, not the files

pickCharacter.title: Pick a character
pickCharacter.detail: Press Luma or Brin. That opens their body and the mouths they already have.

missingBody.title: A body is missing
missingBody.detail: This character does not have the “{{pose}}” pose. Generate a body cutout or use a drawing from the canvas.

approveBody.title: Approve the “{{pose}}” body
approveBody.detail: Without an approved body you cannot place mouths or put it on the scene.

wipeMouth.title: Place the box over the lips
wipeMouth.detail: On “{{pose}}”, drag the yellow box until it covers the mouth. If the drawing still has painted lips, press Wipe mouth area. If it is already clean, press Lock mouths and then Save.

makeMouths.title: Make or approve the mouths
makeMouths.detail: Complete all nine positions, review their placement and try a line with the character’s voice before generating shots.

putOnScene.title: Put it on the scene
putOnScene.detail: “{{name}} · {{pose}}” already has a body and mouths. Press Put on the scene. Then use Cutout dialogue so it can speak.

steps.box: Drag the yellow box until it covers the lips. It saves when you release.
steps.wipe: If the drawing still has a painted mouth, press Wipe mouth area.
steps.eyes: Eyes and blinking are optional. Keep the existing drawing unless you need separate animated eyelids.
steps.scene: Put on the scene and Preview. The mouth and blink animate on their own.

createNew.summary: Create a new body or mouths
createNew.hint: Choose the style and traits for new generated variants. Existing mouth packs are shown below the pose.

faceRig.extraNotesPlaceholder: Only what the tags do not cover…
faceRig.dragBoxHint: Drag the rectangle over the original mouth. Drag its corner horizontally and vertically to change width and height independently. Wiping affects this rectangle; the new mouth keeps its own proportions.

tryLine.sample: The square is frozen and the bell is too loud.
tryLine.missing: Missing {{missing}}; those beats use {{fallback}} as fallback.

faceRig.unsavedHint: Until you press Save, changes are not in the library. The LLM does not see pending pieces.

status.statePending: {{name}} is ready as pending. Drag it onto the lips and press Lock mouths.
status.packGenerated: Generated {{count}} Face Rig states. Review transparency and placement before approval.
status.cleaned: {{name}} cleaned as {{status}}. It stays pending until you approve the placement.
status.planned: Planned {{count}} visemes over {{duration}}s. Missing mouths stay as fallbacks and are not saved.
status.speechReady: Preview speech ready with {{count}} visemes. Nothing was saved to the kit.
status.presetApplied: Applied {{name}} as pending Face Rig mouths. Check placement before approval.
status.mouthSaved: Mouth saved on “{{pose}}”. Preview should already move it.
status.wiped: Painted mouth cleaned on “{{pose}}”. The box is already saved.
status.reviewed: {{name}} {{result}}. Save the kit to publish this review.

warnings.farFromCenter: This overlay sits far from the pose center and may miss the face.
warnings.tooSmall: This overlay is unusually small compared with the pose.
warnings.eyeTooLarge: This eye overlay is larger than a typical eye mask. Scale it down until it only covers the eyes.
warnings.mouthTooLarge: This mouth overlay is larger than a typical viseme. Scale it down until it sits on the lips.
warnings.mouthTooLow: Mouths on a full-body cutout usually sit above the chest. Nudge Down/Up until the overlay covers the lips, then lock all mouths.

faceRig.packHint: Choose a style, preview its mouth positions, then apply the pack to this character. Applied mouths stay pending until you review them.
faceRig.packsUnavailable: No mouth packs are available. Reload the workshop to retry loading the catalog.
faceRig.stepPlace: 1. Cover and erase the original mouth
faceRig.stepChoose: 2. Choose existing mouths or generate new ones
faceRig.stepTry: 3. Try the mouths with a phrase
faceRig.optionalEyesHint: The eyes already drawn on the character are enough. Lip sync only needs mouths. Add separate eye overlays here only if you want to change the eyes or animate eyelids; those pieces need their own placement and review.
faceRig.sampleHint: A recorded English phrase with mouth timings, included with the app. Uses your mouth shapes without generating audio or changing the saved character voice.
faceRig.sampleUnavailable: The included sample could not be loaded.
faceRig.restHint: Saving includes the resting mouth in the reusable character image. It is also used while listening or in silent shots.

facePatch.title: Raster mouth replacement patch
facePatch.experimental: Experimental replacement patch: import a full-image mouth variant generated from the same character reference. The variant must stay aligned to this pose and keep the exact same pixel dimensions. No automatic generator is included.
facePatch.alignment: Preparation runs privately on this device. Nothing is uploaded until you choose Save pending patch. Saving the patch does not save the kit; use the normal Character Kit Save too.
facePatch.promptLabel: Readonly reference prompt for this mouth state
facePatch.variantLabel: Aligned full-image variant (PNG, JPEG or WebP)
facePatch.variantHint: Use the same reference, pose, framing and dimensions. This image replaces a region of the approved base; it is not a transparent mouth sprite.
facePatch.keepTexture: Do not remove this patch’s background: its skin or beard covers the original mouth.
facePatch.stalePose: This patch belongs to a different pose or an earlier image. Prepare it again.
facePatch.wipedPending: A new mouth-cleaned image is ready. Review and approve the pose before mounting it.

disabled.eyes: Raster replacement patches apply only to mouth states. Eyes are handled separately.
disabled.pose: Approve this base pose before preparing a facial patch.
disabled.rotation: Rotate the mouth box back to 0° before preparing a facial patch.

status.prepared: Patch prepared locally. Review the preview before saving.
status.savedPending: Patch saved as pending. Review it, then save the Character Kit separately.
status.cancelled: Cancelled stale patch operation. The newer pose or draft was kept.

errors.fileType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP full-image variant.
errors.prepare: Could not prepare this facial patch.
errors.noPrepared: Prepare a variant before saving the pending patch.

creator.title: Character Creator
creator.subtitle: Create a character from a description or use an existing image. Save it to create its mouths in Lips Creator. You can also use the image for a 360 video and a Hunyuan mesh.
creator.subjectHint: Required. One is enough. MiniMax reads the photo and writes the A Prompt.
creator.extraHint: Optional. Face, outfit, accessory, or another angle.
creator.aPromptPlaceholder: Empty = MiniMax or the internal LLM describe the photos. Other providers require an A Prompt.
creator.engineNote: Isolated ConvRot Character Sheet engine · Native Turbo off to keep the 6-panel orbit.
creator.emptyOrbit: Upload at least one image and generate the orbit
creator.adjustHint: Pick a moment in the video and replace only this view.

status.llmDescribe: The internal LLM is describing the image…
status.orbitInterrupted: The orbit was interrupted by a server restart. Resume reruns the saved queue; discard clears it.

errors.autoDescribe: Auto-describe only works with MiniMax or the internal LLM. Type an A Prompt, or switch Settings → LLM.
errors.faceRigKitsOnly: Face Rig is for Character Kits. Keep Character Creator for identity and turnaround sheets.
errors.needViewOrUpload: Capture a turnaround view or upload the subject image first.

imageCreator.title: Create a character from a description
imageCreator.hint: Start with a name and describe its appearance. No reference image is needed.
imageCreator.name: Character name
imageCreator.placeholder: An elderly magician with silver hair, a burgundy coat and a gentle expression, illustrated in watercolor…
imageCreator.cancelled: Generation cancelled. The previous image is kept.
imageCreator.empty: Your character image will appear here.
imageCreator.review: Review the image. Save it if you want to keep this character.
imageCreator.saved: Character saved. You can now select it as a reference in Lips Creator.
imageCreator.referenceReady: Image ready in the main subject field below.

editorSession.title: Configure {{name}}
editorSession.hint: Configure the voice, mouths for 2D animation and model for 3D lip sync here. Saving links this configuration to the series character.
editorSession.return: Return to the character in Series Lab
editorSession.saveFirst: Use Save everything and return to save all pending settings.
editorSession.saveAllReturn: Save everything and return to Series Lab
editorSession.saveAllHint: Saves voice, mouth images and placement together. Existing approvals are preserved.

lips.collectionHint: Create mouth collections and connect them to speech.
lips.editorHint: Choose a mouth, refine it and hear the result.
lips.name: Collection name
lips.mouthInstructionHint: For example: thinner lips, smaller teeth…
lips.sequenceHint: One click creates every missing mouth, one at a time, and saves each result. You can switch studio tabs while it works.
lips.batchComplete: {{count}} mouth created and saved. Review it before accepting.
lips.batchComplete_other: {{count}} mouths created and saved. Review them before accepting.
lips.batchPartial: {{count}} of {{total}} mouths created and saved. Use Create missing mouths to retry the failed ones.
lips.compareHint: Review the new mouths and accept the ones you like.
lips.accepted: Mouth accepted. Save to keep your changes.
lips.descriptionHint: Describe the mouths and generate them directly. You can link them to a character later.
lips.styleHint: Thin burgundy lips, black outlines, vintage cartoon style…
lips.uploadReference: Or upload a mouth or character reference
lips.needsReference: Choose a character or upload a reference, or switch to Description only.
lips.placeAll: Use this position for every mouth
lips.assignmentsHint: Several sounds can share one mouth. These groups guide audio synchronization.
lips.linkHint: Apply these mouths and assignments to a character. You can adjust placement in its editor.
lips.approveBeforeLink: Accept a mouth for each sound before linking.
lips.characterUnavailable: That character is no longer available.
lips.morphHint: Preview only. Play the phrase to compare; short sounds shorten the transition automatically. Teeth and tongue may show artifacts.
lips.morphUnavailable: This mouth cannot be deformed here. Use a transparent image of the mouth; it is shown directly for now.
lips.morphCompareHint: Move the slider to inspect intermediate shapes. Playing the phrase returns to audio synchronization.

lips.placeCollection: Place the mouth with the controls below, lock all mouths, then save the character. The saved mouths and sound assignments are used by video lip sync.
lips.collectionApplied: Collection applied. Place the mouths and save the character.
lips.reloadHint: Reload saved collections; discard unsaved edits in the open collection.

styleCreator.hint: Describe the character. Three options are made on a plain screen, the background is removed, and the one you pick is saved ready to talk.
styleCreator.placeholder: Kevin, a nervous 24-year-old founder, messy red hair, freckles, orange hoodie…
styleCreator.haze: A haze is left over {{percent}}% of the image: the screen did not key cleanly. Pick another option or generate it again.
styleCreator.noneReady: No option finished. Try again or change the description.
styleCreator.empty: The three options will appear here.
styleCreator.ready: Ready to talk. Check the mouths and the blink below.
styleCreator.unwiped: No painted mouth was found on: {{poses}}. A mouth was placed under the eyes.
styleCreator.warpReview: These mouths are the drawing's own: the upper lip stays and the lower lip and chin move. In the review, check that each pose opens between the lips, not at the nose or a moustache.
styleCreator.mouthLine: Check the mouth line of {{poses}}: the rig was not sure where the lips meet. Open Prepare 2D speech below, pick {{name}} and, in Mouth line, drag the dot onto the line between the lips.
styleCreator.checkPoses: Look at {{poses}} in the review before using {{name}}: the eyes or a mark may have been found in the wrong place.
styleCreator.posePlaceholder: Waving, arms up in panic, pointing…
styleCreator.poseAdded: Pose added and ready to talk.

busy.addPose: Adding the pose and its mouths…

voiceDesigner.hint: Describe the voice by its traits. Start with “Male voice.” or “Female voice.”, then age, pitch, pace and mood. A calm sample line gives a steadier voice. The pitch check is 85–155 Hz for a man, 165–255 for a woman and 220–400 for a child.
voiceDesigner.downloading: Download started. Try again when it finishes.
voiceDesigner.accentSeseo: Castilian θ on {{rate}}% of {{positions}} positions. The voice is kept.
voiceDesigner.placeholder: Male voice. Late twenties, a bit nasal, fast and nervous, friendly.
voiceDesigner.text: Sample line (kept as the reference transcript)
voiceDesigner.pick: Listen, compare the numbers and keep one.

mouthLine.title: Mouth line · {{pose}}
mouthLine.intro: These mouths are the drawing's own: the upper lip stays and the lower lip, chin and beard move down. Drag the dot onto the line between the lips and the two ends to the mouth's corners; the mouth shapes follow as you move.
mouthLine.notWarp: Saving switches this character to these mouths and rigs every pose again.
mouthLine.noOwn: This pose has no mouths of its own yet: place the line and save to make them.
mouthLine.snapped: The line sits on the painted line between the lips.
mouthLine.free: No painted line here: the mouth opens exactly at the dot.
mouthLine.saved: Saved the mouth of {{pose}}. Shots that use this pose keep the old mouth until they are rendered again.
mouthLine.previewOnly: To save the line, open this character in Characters › Prepare 2D speech.

errors.unsaved: Save the character's other changes first: the line is saved by rigging the saved character again.
errors.save: Could not save the mouth line.

mouthLine.unsure: The face points were unsure here (a moustache, a beard, a face seen from below): check that the line is between the lips.
mouthLine.smallFace: Small face (head {{head}} px): the mouths are warped on the face enlarged {{times}}×, fitted back to the pose and opened a little deeper, so they read when the figure is drawn small.
mouthLine.headPass: Its face points were read on the head alone.
